title: Aney Synodeias
artist_note:
This work began taking shape at the Ano Liosia bus station in the spring of 2023, when Nikiforos and I were waiting for a missed bus to Larissa and he remembered to bring his "notebook" with his poems. Back then, I was reading them and listening to them simultaneously, as they possessed a very distinct musicality. The following year, they were published by Iolkos Publishing, and from then on, for the next two years, I set them to music, arranged them, and built something that would take physical form in October 2026—against all odds, as the production I had put together was highly complex and elaborate, exceeding our financial and practical budgets. It was something I had never done before. Throughout this journey, alongside Nikiforos as a companion and all the contributors, this dream came true, and I feel happy and blessed to have learned so much and connected with all these people who contributed, both seen and unseen.

This work is crafted with A LOT of love by MANY wonderful people.

Enjoy irresponsibly.
